profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with strong object oriented programming foundation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: • Worked with cross functional teams at Google Nest to ship new thermostat products and develop core thermostat features in Google Home iOS App.

positions.title: Principal iOS Developer
positions.description:
• Worked as a Product Development Lead for Ad Revenue Product group to accomplish the goals and objectives of advertising clients. (DFP/AdMob/A9)
• Worked closely with Mobile Product team and other Gannett units such as USA Today and the US Community Publishing Division to develop and maintain iOS apps. (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/usa-today-news-personalized/id504631398)

positions.title: Senior iOS Developer
positions.description:
• Responsible for development, testing, release, and support of Gannett mobile initiatives and services.
• Worked with other developers, designers, and product/business managers to develop new features consistent with product roadmap.

positions.title: Mobile Architect
positions.description:
• Managed mobile application development for various internal and external projects for Android / iOS / Windows platforms.
• Analyzed trends in technology innovations and provided solutions to address technology and business issues.
• Worked closely with senior technology leadership to develop mobile strategy.
• Managed multiple SCRUM teams across several projects.

positions.title: iOS Subject Matter Expert
positions.description:
• Developed Woozy Labs – United against germs, a community-based flu and germ tracker which combines reporting and tracking features as well as SpriteKit game to engage diverse users. (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/woozy-recall-safety-alerts/id969894256)
• Developed SpouseLink, a free social networking app linking military spouses around the world which has messaging, news feeds, and group posting features.
• Developed Zoomph Social Manager, a real-time social moderation so that users can take control of their brand's social media content.
• Developed Georgia Counties by ACCG, which serves as a resource for Georgia residents, ACCG membership and others. It provides information such as the names and contact information of elected and appointed officials, county history, courthouse photos, and bills affecting county government.
• Developed eBriefing for iPad, which allows user to download books to view offline, add annotations, bookmark pages, and receive notifications for updated books.
• Developed DOSCareers for U.S. Department of State which helps those who are interested in a Foreign Service Careers by learning more about opportunities and experiences of those who have chosen this career as well as take practice tests from their iPhone. DOSCareers hit more than 42,000 downloads. (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/doscareers/id1305222226)
• Developed Amazing Ocean by Smithsonian, which allows users to discover about facts about our oceans and involve in various discussion topics from their iPhone.
• Developed SPtoGO – SharePoint To Go, which allows easy integration of SharePoint to iPhone with intuitive user experience and navigation.
• Developed AAFMAA that lets insurance account holders to pay their insurance bills through secure interface. (https://apps.apple.com/kn/app/aafmaa/id714636436)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented Archive Manager to give end users ability to add/delete/edit archives from Cisco Video Surveillance Media Server (VSMS).
• Designed and implemented Video/Archive Matrix for the end users to continuously monitor all surveillance video cameras and archives.
• Designed and implemented remote video viewing application, RemoteVFL, to give end users the ability to access and control live surveillance video streams remotely from mobile device and laptop workstation.
• Conducted training sessions to aid in Video/Archive applications.
• Implemented Video Capture library to capture current desktop or specific windows in the desktop in video format.
• Implemented Video Feed library to capture videos from camera encoders in JPEG / MJPEG / MPEG4 type.
• Implemented Audio Feed library to capture audios from camera encoders and integrate with videos.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for smooth communications between Windows Mobile CE OS and Qualcomm Modem Chips.
• Conducted automated software functionality testing with Microsoft CETK and LTK to provide accurate functionalities on mobile.
• Enabled HSDPA 3.6 Mbps and 7.2 Mbps data transmission rate on mobile terminal.
• Implemented test applications on Incoming/Outgoing voice call, GPRS, and Data Dormancy.
